types.description: Murrelektronik MCS 20-115-230/24 MIT PFC, single-phase power supply, adjustable 24–28 VDC output

modelingNotes: Murr is the required historical catalog label; manufacturer is Murrelektronik. Exact article 85063; no successor substitution.
Diagram numbering is retained: 1 earth, 2 N, 3 L, 4/5 DC−, 6/7 DC+. Output connector-local positions 1–4 in the product table correspond to the diagram's 4–7, not additional terminals.

Historical manufacturer sheet Created 11/12, pages 1–2: https://se-import.com/documents/catalog/powering/murr/switch_mode/85063.pdf. Input 90–265 VAC, 50/60 Hz, or 110–300 VDC; input current 5.5 A at 100 VAC / 2.4 A at 230 VAC. Exact operating manual V1.5 specifies 90–265 VAC and does not describe DC-input polarity. DC polarity and installed revision remain unverified; no polarity-insensitive DC input is claimed.

Output 24 VDC SELV ±1%, adjustable 24–28 V. Historical sheet and exact manual specify 20 A at +60 °C, with manual UL condition +40 °C; 24 A at +40 °C requires 110–265 VAC input. These are total output capabilities, not independent current allowances per clamp. No nominal_voltage scalar is assigned to this adjustable universal-input device.

Explicit factory common paths 4–5 and 6–7 are shown in both exact-article diagrams; author them as project jumpers. No input-to-output, PE-to-return, or other fixed link is asserted. Function metadata does not create continuity.

Input 2/3 and earth 1 are required for the powered abstraction. Repeated output clamps are individually application-dependent. Shared output policy supports explicit internal jumpers plus field leads, not a physical clamp conductor-count claim.

Exact manufacturer operating instructions 85063_ina_4_15.pdf, V1.5, physical page 2: https://shop.murrelektronik.com/out/media/85063_ina_4_15.pdf. Front AUTORESTART jumper ON is the factory default and enables repeated pulsed restart; OFF shuts down for overcurrent, overvoltage or overtemperature. OFF-mode restart requires a 2-minute mains disconnection. The manual requires at least 5 minutes disconnected before changing the jumper. These mode labels are settings, not numbered terminals. Pin count, markings and selectable pin-to-pin paths are not exposed in the drawing, so configuration contacts remain unmodeled; no permanent mode link is asserted.

Manual page 2 identifies safety class I and field protective-earth terminal 1. The four M4 screws shown in mounting figures are mechanical fixings, not documented additional PE terminals. No separate housing-bond position or fixed PE-to-output-return link is established. The voltage-adjust potentiometer and output-OK LED are local controls/indicators, not remote signal contacts.

connectionCoverage.notes: Seven numbered power-interface clamps and the 4–5 and 6–7 output common links are documented. Manual V1.5 establishes AUTORESTART ON/OFF behavior but does not expose selector contact count, pin markings or selectable continuity; these configuration contacts remain outside the model. Any separate housing-bond positions and DC-input polarity remain unverified.
